sentences.text: This second application under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 has been filed for grant of bail.

2. Applicant has been arrested on 04.07.2024 in connection with Crime No.402/2024 registered at Police Station Barwani, District Barwani for offence under Sections 363, 366-A, 376, 376(2)(n),
376(3) of IPC and under Section 3/4, 5(j)(ii)/6, 5(L)/6 of the POCSO Act.

3. It is submitted by counsel for applicant that although the prosecutrix has turned hostile and has stated that she never underwent abortion but abortion was done on the directions of CWC.
4.
The prosecutrix might have turned hostile but still the accused can be convicted on the basis of scientific evidence.

5. Faced with such a situation, counsel for applicant seeks permission of NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-IND:26655 2 MCRC-39347-2024 this Court to withdraw this application.
6. It is accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn .
